added.member: UI: CSS object-fit on , object-position and image-rendering in documents
added.summary: object-fit takes fill, contain, cover, none and scale-down on (none and scale-down on too); object-position places the image as background-position is written, edge offsets included, and replaces 's focal point; image-rendering pixelated and crisp-edges (inherited) sample every image an element draws at the nearest texel.

added.member: og-render: UiImage offset and nearest, UiFit::ScaleDown
added.summary: UiImage.offset adds CSS px to where focal places a cover, contain or none image, UiImage.nearest samples the nearest texel of the top level whatever the texture's filter, UiFit::ScaleDown contains without scaling up, and a zero UiImage.size reads the region's own pixels from the texture.
